Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class TimeZoneStatus

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.TimeZoneStatus
public final class TimeZoneStatus extends Object
System date/time-zone discovery and management for the control center.

Mirrors the PrinterStatus seam shape: the parsing, formatting and command-building are pure and unit-tested (parseProperty(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), parseBoolean(java.lang.String), parseTimezone(java.lang.String), parseNtpEnabled(java.lang.String), parseLocalTime(java.lang.String), parseTimezones(java.lang.String), setTimezoneCommand(java.lang.String), setNtpCommand(boolean)); the probes are thin wrappers over timedatectl. On a host without systemd every probe degrades to an empty result / false rather than throwing, so the panel shows a read-only note instead of failing. Setting the zone or NTP normally needs administrator privileges (polkit); a denied call simply returns false.
